title: The War of Bloodlines
summary: Inside the Primordial Mindscape, Ha-Jun confronts the manifestation of his ancient lineage—a chaotic war between the original Demon Sovereign's memories and his own human soul.

panels.shot: the primordial mindscape: an endless black ocean beneath red nebulas
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands on an infinite surface of calm black water reflecting millions of crimson stars and swirling galaxies.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands on an infinite surface of calm black water reflecting millions of crimson stars and swirling galaxies.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shant kale pani ki ek anant satah par khada hai jo lakhon lal rang ke sitaron aur ghumti akashgangaon ko pratibimbit karta hai.

panels.shot: floating above the water: thousands of glowing memory crystals
panels.action: Thousands of crystalline shards float in mid-air, each displaying a battle or coronation from five thousand years of demon history.
panels.prose_en: Thousands of crystalline shards float in mid-air, each displaying a battle or coronation from five thousand years of demon history.
panels.prose_hi: Hajaron crystaliy tukde madhya hawa mein tairte han, pratyek rakshas ke paanch hajar saal ke itihaas se yudh ya rajyabhishek ko pradarshit karta hai.

panels.shot: kuro flying beside ha-jun in radiant purple phoenix aura
panels.action: Kuro glides across the water surface: 'This is the Absolute Root of the Sovereign Bloodline. Every past emperor's will sleeps here.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yahan past ke 99 Sovereigns ka consciousness rehta hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides across the water surface: 'This is the Absolute Root of the Sovereign Bloodline. Every past emperor's will sleeps here.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro pani ki satah par sarkata hai: 'yah samprabhu raktarekha ki purna jad hai. har pichle badshah ki vasiyat yahin soti hai.'

panels.shot: a dark silhouette rising from the black water fifty yards ahead
panels.action: From the calm black water rises a figure identical in height and build to Ha-Jun, clad in obsidian dragon armor.
panels.prose_en: From the calm black water rises a figure identical in height and build to Ha-Jun, clad in obsidian dragon armor.
panels.prose_hi: Shant kale pani se unchai aur banavat mein Ha-Jun ke samaan ek aakriti ubharti hai, jo obsidian dragon kavach pahane hue hai.

panels.shot: the figure looking up: dark ha-jun with pitch-black sclera and burning red pupils
panels.action: The doppelganger looks up: Ha-Jun's exact handsome face, but with black sclera, burning crimson irises, and two obsidian horns.

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Welcome to your true self, Ha-Jun Kang.

panels.prose_en: The doppelganger looks up: Ha-Jun's exact handsome face, but with black sclera, burning crimson irises, and two obsidian horns.
panels.prose_hi: Humshakl upar dekhti hai: Ha-Jun ka bilkul sundar chehra, lekin kale shwetpatal, jalti hui lal rang ki putli aur do obsidian seeng ke sath.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the sanguine fang pointing it at the shadow
panels.action: Ha-Jun unsheathes his starlight blade: 'You are the Void Primordial that infected Asmodaius.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum mere andar ka darr aur nafrat ho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun unsheathes his starlight blade: 'You are the Void Primordial that infected Asmodaius.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne starlight blade ko khol diya: 'aap shunya aadim hain jisne esmodius ko sankramit kiya.'

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun drawing a mirror blade of black anti-matter
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun unsheathes an identical katana forged of pitch-black void anti-matter: 'I am not just fear. I am your absolute power!'

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Without me, you are just a weak student who wept on a rooftop!

panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun unsheathes an identical katana forged of pitch-black void anti-matter: 'I am not just fear. I am your absolute power!'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun ne pich-black shunya anti-mater se bane ek samaan katana ko khol diya: 'main sirf dar nahin hun. main aapki purna shakti hun!

panels.shot: the two ha-juns sprinting across the black water at mach 15
panels.action: The light and dark versions of Ha-Jun sprint across the black ocean, water splashing in supersonic wake rings.
panels.prose_en: The light and dark versions of Ha-Jun sprint across the black ocean, water splashing in supersonic wake rings.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke halke aur gahre sanskaran supersonic wake rings mein pani ki bauchhar karte hue kale sagar mein teji se daudte han.

panels.shot: blades collide: a massive shockwave of starlight and void splits the ocean
panels.action: Katana meets katana; a mile-wide trench opens in the black ocean as red and purple lightning arcs into the nebulas.
panels.prose_en: Katana meets katana; a mile-wide trench opens in the black ocean as red and purple lightning arcs into the nebulas.
panels.prose_hi: Katana katana se milta hai; jaise hi lal aur baingani rang ki bijli neeharikaon mein chamakti hai, kale sagar mein ek meal chaudi khai khul jaati hai.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun kicking ha-jun chest sending him skipping across water
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun drives an armored boot into Ha-Jun's ribs, sending him skipping across the water surface like a flat stone.
panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun drives an armored boot into Ha-Jun's ribs, sending him skipping across the water surface like a flat stone.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun ne Ha-Jun ki pasliyon mein ek bakhtarband boot dala, jisse wah ek sapat patthar ki tarah pani ki satah par kood gaya.

panels.shot: ha-jun planting his boots digging trenches in the water to halt
panels.action: Ha-Jun digs his boots into the surface tension, stopping his skid fifty yards away, breathing hard.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: His strength... It's exactly identical to mine!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun digs his boots into the surface tension, stopping his skid fifty yards away, breathing hard.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne jute satah ke tanaav mein gada die, jisse unki fislan pachas gaj door ruk gai aur unhone jor se saans li.

panels.shot: kuro diving with burning talons raking across shadow ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Kuro dives in, raking his solar talons across Shadow Ha-Jun's pauldron, sending black sparks flying.
panels.prose_en: Kuro dives in, raking his solar talons across Shadow Ha-Jun's pauldron, sending black sparks flying.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro gota lagata hai, shadow Ha-Jun ke pauladron par apne saur panje ghumata hai, jisse kali chingariyan udti han.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun backhanding kuro with a dark gravitational pulse
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun backhands Kuro with an anti-gravity pulse, blasting the phoenix fifty yards across the water.
panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun backhands Kuro with an anti-gravity pulse, blasting the phoenix fifty yards across the water.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun ne anti-gravity pulse ke saath Kuro ko backhand kiya, jisse phoenix ko pani mein pachas gaj ki doori par uda diya gaya.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun leaping 100 feet in the air bringing both hands down
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun rockets into the sky, swinging his void blade down in a colossal guillotine stroke.
panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun rockets into the sky, swinging his void blade down in a colossal guillotine stroke.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun aakash mein rocket karta hai, ek vishal gilotin stroke mein apne shunya blade ko neeche jhukata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting chains of ruin to snare shadow ha-jun arms mid-air
panels.action: Ha-Jun summons Chains of Ruin; four heavy black links wrap around the shadow's wrists, freezing him in mid-air.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun summons Chains of Ruin; four heavy black links wrap around the shadow's wrists, freezing him in mid-air.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne chains off ruin ko bulaya; char bhari kali kadiyan chhaya ki kalaiyon ke charon or lapetati han, jisse wah hawa mein hi jam jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun pulling the chains slamming shadow ha-jun into the water
panels.action: Ha-Jun yanks the chains with both arms, slamming his dark reflection face-first into the black water.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun yanks the chains with both arms, slamming his dark reflection face-first into the black water.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun donon hathon se janjeeron ko khinchta hai, aur apne andhere chhaya ko pehle kale pani mein patak deta hai.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun dissolving into black liquid and reforming behind ha-jun
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun liquefies into the black water and reconstitutes directly behind Ha-Jun's back with blade poised.
panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun liquefies into the black water and reconstitutes directly behind Ha-Jun's back with blade poised.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun kale pani mein dravit ho jaati hai aur Ha-Jun ki peeth ke peeche sidhe blade ke saath punargathit ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun whispering in ha-jun ear: 'why do you fight to protect mortals?'
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun whispers into his ear: 'Mortals beat you. They called you an orphan. Why die for them?'

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Humans hated you. Why not let them burn?

panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun whispers into his ear: 'Mortals beat you. They called you an orphan. Why die for them?'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun uske kaan mein fusfusati hai: 'nashwar log tumhe harate han. unhone tumhe anath kaha. unke liye kyon maren?'

panels.shot: ha-jun elbows backward smashing shadow ha-jun in the jaw
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives a reinforced elbow straight into the shadow's jaw, shattering teeth and knocking him back.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Because my brother loved me. And Min-Jae stood by me.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drives a reinforced elbow straight into the shadow's jaw, shattering teeth and knocking him back.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek majboot kohni sidhe chhaya ke jabde mein maarta hai, daant tod deta hai aur use peeche dhakel deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun spinning and slashing across shadow ha-jun chestplate
panels.action: Ha-Jun follows with a spinning horizontal cleave, carving a deep wound across the shadow's obsidian armor.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun follows with a spinning horizontal cleave, carving a deep wound across the shadow's obsidian armor.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek ghumte hue kshaitij daraar ke saath chalta hai, jo chhaya ke obsidian kavach par ek gehra ghav banata hai.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun laughing wiping black blood from his split lip
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun wipes black ichor from his lip, laughing with dark joy: 'Yes! That hatred! That anger! Give it to me!'

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: Every drop of wrath you feel makes me stronger!

panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun wipes black ichor from his lip, laughing with dark joy: 'Yes! That hatred! That anger! Give it to me!'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun apne hothon se kali ichor ponchti hai, gahre anand se hansti hai: 'han! wah nafarat! wah crodh! ise mujhe de do!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun realizing the paradox: fighting with anger only feeds the shadow
panels.action: Ha-Jun freezes; he sees his own anger flowing like dark mist into the shadow's muscles.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: I can't destroy him with hatred... That's what created him in the first place.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun freezes; he sees his own anger flowing like dark mist into the shadow's muscles.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jam jata hai; wah apne krodh ko parchhai ki manspeshiyon mein kali dhundh ki tarah bahta hua dekhta hai.

panels.shot: shadow ha-jun expanding into a 30-foot demonic titan of anti-matter
panels.action: Shadow Ha-Jun swells into a colossal thirty-foot demon monarch, wielding a 20-foot broadsword of black flame.

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hajun
dialogue.text: I AM THE ACCUMULATED WRATH OF FIVE THOUSAND YEARS!!

panels.prose_en: Shadow Ha-Jun swells into a colossal thirty-foot demon monarch, wielding a 20-foot broadsword of black flame.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya Ha-Jun ek vishal tees foot ke danav samrat mein tabdil ho jata hai, jiske haath mein 20 foot ki kali lau wali chaudi talwar hoti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun sheathing the sanguine fang with a quiet click
panels.action: Ha-Jun lowers his arms and slides the blood katana back into its scabbard with a calm, decisive click.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lowers his arms and slides the blood katana back into its scabbard with a calm, decisive click.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni bhujaen neeche kar deta hai aur ek shant, nirnayak click ke saath khoon katana ko wapas uske myan mein daal deta hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing beside ha-jun watching with breathless curiosity
panels.action: Kuro tilts his head: 'Ha-Jun... What are you doing?'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: You are putting away your sword?!

panels.prose_en: Kuro tilts his head: 'Ha-Jun... What are you doing?'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apna sir jhukata hai: 'Ha-Jun... tum kya kar rahe ho?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking calmly toward the 30-foot shadow titan with open hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks calmly across the water toward the towering titan, hands empty, eyes serene and clear.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: You are not my enemy. You are just my pain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks calmly across the water toward the towering titan, hands empty, eyes serene and clear.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun vishal titan ki or pani ke paar shanti se chalta hai, haath khali han, aankhen shant aur spasht han.

panels.shot: shadow titan swinging the 20-foot broadsword down at ha-jun head
panels.action: The colossal black sword crashes down directly at Ha-Jun's exposed, unarmored head.
panels.prose_en: The colossal black sword crashes down directly at Ha-Jun's exposed, unarmored head.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal kali talwar sidhe Ha-Jun ke ujagar, nihatthe sir par girti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching the giant blade with a gentle touch of both palms
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't block with force; he catches the edge between gentle, glowing palms, diffusing the kinetic energy.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun doesn't block with force; he catches the edge between gentle, glowing palms, diffusing the kinetic energy.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun balpurvak nahin rokta; wah komal, chamakti hatheliyon ke beech ke kinare ko pakadta hai, jisse gatij urja failti hai.

panels.shot: golden starlight flowing from ha-jun hands into the dark blade
panels.action: Warm golden light flows from Ha-Jun's skin, turning the pitch-black anti-matter blade into clean crystal glass.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: I accept you. You kept me alive when I was weak. But you don't control me anymore.

panels.prose_en: Warm golden light flows from Ha-Jun's skin, turning the pitch-black anti-matter blade into clean crystal glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki tvacha se garm sunhari roshni bahti hai, jo pich-kale anti-mater blade ko saaf crystal glass mein badal deti hai.

panels.shot: the shadow titan cracking with blinding golden fractures cliffhanger
panels.action: Spiderweb fractures of pure golden light spread across the 30-foot titan as integration begins!

dialogue.text: THE SHADOW SUBMITS. THE TRUE SOVEREIGN EMERGES.

panels.prose_en: Spiderweb fractures of pure golden light spread across the 30-foot titan as integration begins!.
panels.prose_hi: Ekikaran shuru hote hi shuddh sunhari roshni ke spiderweb fracture 30 foot ke titan mein fail gaye!
